name: hyniqe-hub
description: Hyniqe Hub: free, open-source solutions for settlement and payment operations data. SSI Checker, Duplicate Payment Finder, Payment Data Repair.

scripts.bench: node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning solutions/ssi-checker/bench.ts --out out --min-recall 0.99 --max-false 0.01 && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning solutions/duplicate-payments/bench.ts --out out --min-recall 0.9 --min-precision-high 0.99
scripts.prebuild:site: npm run -s bench && cd engine && npm run -s seed && node --disable-warning=ExperimentalWarning scripts/benchmark.ts --set holdout --out out
